GH-1154: linked-test sandbox guard is command-shape inconsistent and undocumented

The linked-test add guard rejects direct node --test commands containing space-separated flags but accepts equivalent execution through sh -c, equals-spelled flags, or alternate runners. This makes the policy both bypassable and unnecessarily obstructive, while pm test help does not disclose content validation.
